name: jlcpcb-4layer-2oz

quotes.minimum_via_annular_ring_mm: ① Via diameter should be 0.1mm(0.15mm preferred) larger than Via hole size.
quotes.minimum_via_drill_mm: Min. Via hole size/diameter: 0.15/0.25mm (0.1mm/0.2mm only available for board thickness ≤1mm; ENIG/OSP surface finish required)
quotes.minimum_copper_to_edge_mm: Routed: ① Copper clearance from routed board edges: ≧0.2 mm
quotes.minimum_annular_ring_mm: PTH annular ring, multilayer: 2 oz: 0.254 mm or above
quotes.minimum_track_width_mm: Trace width/spacing, 2 oz: Multilayer: 0.15 / 0.15 mm (6 / 6 mil)
quotes.minimum_pth_drill_mm: Drill Diameter: Multilayer: 0.15 – 6.3 mm (0.1mm microvias only available for board thickness ≤1mm; ENIG/OSP surface finish required)
quotes.maximum_pth_drill_mm: Drill Diameter: Multilayer: 0.15 – 6.3 mm (0.1mm microvias only available for board thickness ≤1mm; ENIG/OSP surface finish required)

derivations.minimum_via_annular_ring_mm: Via ring = (diameter - hole) / 2 = 0.1 mm / 2 = 0.05 mm (the stated minimum, not the 0.15 mm preferred margin).

notes: Ring limits are the vendor's absolute minimum; JLC's 'recommended' figure is kept in the quote but not enforced.
The 0.254 mm 2 oz figure is JLC's PTH (component-hole) ring; vias have their own rule (diameter >= hole + 0.1 mm), which is the via ring limit here.
Hole spacing: via/via pairs use 'Via Hole-to-Hole Spacing'; every other pair uses 'Pad Hole-to-Hole Spacing'. JLC does not state a via-to-pad hole rule.
Holes above the PTH maximum are not impossible: 'Holes with diameter ≥ 6.3 mm are CNC routed from a smaller drilled hole.' Treat a DRILL_SIZE maximum finding as a process change, not a hard reject.
Track spacing is enforced by the board's native KiCad DRC rules; this profile checks minimum track width only.
